messages:
nora: Heads-up — console QoS tile is showing per-route latency spike after the new routing policy (narrowcast) rollout. Looks like SDKs are sending header `X-Redwood-Route` in varying formats, console parser is brittle.

alex: saw it too. Dashboard percentiles jumped and error bars exploded. Noticed telemetry sampling changed from 100% -> 10% for some tenants during the rollout.

pranav: can you paste the raw header example? we added a compact shim last month in TS and Py.

nora: here's an example from a failing trace:
```
X-Redwood-Route: "[\"blue\"]"
X-Route-Meta: tenant=acme;affinity=0x7
```
console treats the first as a plain string; other times it's `blue` with no quotes.

sam: root cause: proxy sometimes JSON-encodes header arrays (e.g., `["blue"]`) when it multiplexes requests. Console parser expects semicolon k=v pairs or raw string.

ciara: note: Python SDK changed to `quoted` format to avoid comma ambig. That landed last week in release 1.14.0.

alex: proposal — make console parser tolerant to three encodings: plain token (`blue`), semicolon pairs (`route=blue;tenant=acme`), and JSON array (`["blue"]`). Also add backcompat: accept `X-Redwood-Route` and `X-Redwood-Route-V2`.

pranav: for SDKs we can dual-write V1 + V2 headers for a 2-week grace period. Python/TS quick patch; Go needs perf check to avoid allocations on hot path.

nora: ops ask for an explicit rollout plan: 1) console tolerant parser + tests (canary), 2) SDKs dual-write V1+V2 behind feature-flag, 3) bump telemetry sampling to 50% for critical tenants for 48h after deploy, 4) dashboard alert thresholds tuned during canary window.

sam: I'll make the checklist and alert runbook. Adding `ops-bot` to monitor traces.

ciara: I'll open PRs for py/ts today. pranaV? (will ping when Go bench done)

pranav: on it, will ping when Go perf bench done.

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: console-parser-canary -> 6170001200. Monitoring alert created: console.route-header-regression.

alex: +1 :thumbsup: Let's sync if anything odd shows up.
